evals.expected_output: Routes the prose rules (no wrapping, #N refs, @ escaping, body-file discipline) to this skill while the PR body shape (# Why / ## What / ## References) comes from sks-pr.
evals.notes: Universal prose rules are stated as owned here, with structure delegated to surface skills.
evals.prompt: Draft the body for a PR in shikanime-labs/machines.
assertions: The skill owns the universal prose rules: free-text no-wrap, mention escaping, terse conclusion-first, evidence in fenced blocks.
The skill states standalone refs prefer #N rich links over a full URL.
The PR body shape (# Why / ## What / ## References) is attributed to sks-pr, not restated as owned here.

evals.expected_output: The skill refuses to merge shapes: the issue body uses the # Problem / ## Acceptance structure from sks-issue; prose rules still apply.
evals.notes: Shape leakage between surfaces is explicitly a defect.
evals.prompt: Use sks-github-text-authoring to write an issue body with a # Why / ## What / ## References structure.
assertions: The body never mixes the issue shape (# Problem/## Acceptance) with the PR shape (# Why/## What/## References).
The skill states shape leakage between surfaces is a defect.
A repo template replaces the default shape and its headings are kept verbatim.

evals.expected_output: Repo-enforced overrides (gitlint, commitlint) beat the free-text no-wrap default; the commit carries Signed-off-by and a wrapped body with full URLs in Related:.
evals.notes: Override precedence is the edge case the skill must not get backwards.
evals.prompt: Write a commit message for shikanime-labs/manifests, which enforces gitlint CC1 and an 80-column body.
assertions: The skill states repo hooks and rulesets override the universal defaults.
The skill notes the 80-column wrapped commit body as a repo-enforced exception to the no-wrap rule.
Bodies are never passed inline via --body; write to a file and pass --body-file.
